summary: And to #cs4all folks out there isn't about code or arguing over compsci or iste standards. It is about the art of the self and the design of community. Rooting #literacies in HTML/CSS provides greatest access to most people and anchors schools and communities to web

Rooting #literacies in HTML/CSS provides greatest access to most people and anchors schools and communities to web
